capabilities: Track series episodes and movies on dashboard views with filters, sorts, and stats
Fetch posters, genres, and air dates from TMDb, including lookup by IMDb ID
Mark episodes watched via per-episode task checkboxes with watched-date stamps
Auto-derive show status from watch state and air dates
Rate titles, tag moods, and record streaming-provider availability
extras: Dashboard only reads notes with type: series or type: movie frontmatter in configured folders (defaults Media/Series and Media/Movies); other notes are silently skipped. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track TV and movie viewing or surface a watchlist dashboard over plain note files.

relations.evidence: Both sections search and fetch metadata from the free TMDb API — you'll need your own key.
Notes still store an IMDb URL in source_url for portability

summary: Dashboard and episode tracker for TV series and movies stored as Markdown notes, with TMDb metadata, ratings, and watch state.
